rationale: Keeps the winning 9x512 recurrent-tail baseline intact but reallocates the single FP16-kept attention V matrix from the last block to the first recurrent-tail block. The hypothesis is that earlier recurrent-tail V precision is more leverageful because its attention output is reused and then processed by the remaining tail path before final quantized export, while compressed size stays essentially flat.
title: Shift Tail V Rescue To The First Recurrent Block
